speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development in respect of each of the Social Service Offices (SSOs) (a) how many Singaporeans and Permanent Residents (PRs) who come under their geographical purviews respectively are recipients of ComCare Short-to-Medium Term Assistance and Long-Term Assistance, respectively, as of 31 December 2024; and (b) what is the total population of Singaporeans and PRs that each of the SSOs oversee for their respective geographical areas.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Can I just enquire, for the geographical areas covered by these SSOs that showed the highest number of households requiring SMTA and LTA, does the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) publish this SSO-specific information on its website, and is there any reason why it does not do so?

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: The second question is with regard to the assistance, I understand there is income guideline which is $800 per capita.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: And I understand even if the individual who comes to the SSO exceeds this guideline, SSO will still make an assessment.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: Just a quick follow-up to the Senior Parliamentary Secretary.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: MSF released a report just two-odd months ago, "Supporting Low-income Household Trends report", I think there is some data.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: But again, the data is, as the Senior Parliamentary Secretary said, at the national level.
